Outhouses; dump station ($5/use). Water available May-Sep. FCFS, self-pay box at the entrance (cash/check). Hawkins Mill Pond (9-acre) nearby with fishing dock. --Claude

was: Recreation area on 220-acre Blackhawk Lake between Highland and Cobb.  The Wisconsin DNR owns the land, Iowa County holds an operating easement and the Cobb-Highland Recreation Commission runs it on no state or county tax money; it is not a state park, and state park passes don't work.  Over 150 open and wooded sites for campers, tents and groups, with shower houses and flush toilets, a beach, a boat launch on a no-wake lake, a nature center and hiking trails.  No generators for now, and no ATVs or UTVs.  As read on 2026-10-14, every reservation has a 2-night minimum, 3 on holiday weekends. --Claude
